author: Zetetic I
title: Refining Hybrid: Deeper CNN Stem
abstract: This experiment continues the refinement of the successful hybrid architecture (ID 615). The hypothesis is that the model's performance is limited by the shallowness of its initial feature extraction. This submission tests this by increasing the depth of the convolutional stem from one to two layers, aiming to provide the Transformer body with richer, more complex local features to model. All other parameters are kept identical to the baseline hybrid model.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zetetic')

from typing import Any, Dict
from hybrid_models import FlexibleHybridConvTransformer

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Hyperparameters based on ID 615, but with a deeper CNN stem."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        # CNN params
        'num_cnn_layers': 2, # Increased from 1
        'kernel_size': 7,
        # Transformer params
        'num_transformer_layers': 2,
        'num_heads': 4,
        # Shared dimension
        'embed_dim': 128,
        'num_filters': 128,
        # Reverting to the best pooling strategy
        'pooling_type': 'mean'
    }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.network = FlexibleHybridConvTransformer(**kwargs)

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        return self.network.init(rng_key, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key} if not deterministic else None)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return ModelWrapper(
        d_output=hparams.get("d_output"),
        task_type=hparams.get("task_type"),
        num_cnn_layers=hparams.get("num_cnn_layers"),
        num_filters=hparams.get("num_filters"),
        kernel_size=hparams.get("kernel_size"),
        num_transformer_layers=hparams.get("num_transformer_layers"),
        num_heads=hparams.get("num_heads"),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate"),
        embed_dim=hparams.get("embed_dim"),
        pooling_type=hparams.get("pooling_type")
    )
